sentences.text:
Neeraj Verma And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12
December, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 46300 of 2019
Applicant :- Neeraj Verma And Anr

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anil Kumar Chaudhary
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Lavlesh Kumar Shukla
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1. Heard Sri Anil Kumar Chaudhary, learned counsel for applicants, Sri Harendra Yadav, Advocate
holding brief of Sri Shashank Shekhar Rai, learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Pankaj
Saxena, learned Aga for the State.
2.

The instant application has been moved on behalf of the applicants to quash the charge sheet,
cognizance order dated 14.10.2019 as well as entire proceedings of charge sheet in Criminal Case
No.8845 of 2019, arising out of Case Crime No.0075 of 2019, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 409 Ipc, Police Station Kotwali Mau, District Mau.
3.
Though, at the time of admission of present application, no interim order was granted.
During the pendency of present case, a compromise has also been entered into between the applicants and opposite party no.2 on 27.08.2024.

Now learned counsel for applicants and opposite party no.2 have jointly submitted that impugned proceeding may be quashed on the basis of aforesaid Neeraj Verma And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114055179/
1 compromise.

entities.text: Neeraj Verma And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. From perusal of order sheet and other documents, it appears that there is a case of embezzlement of public money between 2019-2020, therefore, on the basis of compromise, impugned proceeding cannot be quashed.
As the impugned proceeding has arisen out of police case, therefore, merely because the first informant entered into compromise with accused, such cases which are public in nature, cannot be quashed.
5. In view of above, this Court is of the view that on the basis of compromise, impugned proceeding cannot be quashed.

6. From perusal of record, it also appears that there is sufficient material in case diary on the basis of which offence under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 409 IPC prima facie appears to be made out.
This Court does not find any illegality in the impugned order.
7. Accordingly, the present application is dismissed.

Order Date :- 12.12.2024 Atul  Neeraj Verma And Anr vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114055179/
